description: Na₄RuH₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.31 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.50 Å. Ru²⁺ is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent H¹⁻ atoms. All Ru-H bond lengths are 1.74 Å. H¹⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and one Ru²⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing HNa₄Ru square pyramids.
